title: Syrian Oven Roasted Kebabs with Black Beans
description: A flavorful and nutritious recipe that combines the rich taste of Syrian spices with the convenience of oven-roasted kebabs and black beans.

ingredients.name: Oven-roasted kebabs
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or make your own with beef, chicken, or lamb

ingredients.name: Syrian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Place kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush kebabs with olive oil and sprinkle with Syrian spice blend.
Roast kebabs in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While kebabs are roasting, mix cooked black beans with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve kebabs with black beans and garnish with chopped parsley.
Offer lemon wedges on the side for squeezing over the top.
